name: omnifocus-mcp-enhanced
description: 🚀 NEW: Native Custom Perspective Access! Enhanced MCP server with OmniFocus custom perspective support, hierarchical task display, AI-optimized tool selection, and comprehensive task management

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && tsc --noCheck && npm run copy-files && npm run prune-dist && chmod 755 dist/server.js
scripts.build:test: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && tsc --noCheck && npm run copy-files && chmod 755 dist/server.js
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --test dist/*.test.js dist/context/*.test.js dist/tools/definitions/*.test.js dist/tools/*.test.js dist/tools/primitives/*.test.js dist/utils/*.test.js scripts/*.test.mjs
